senses.definition: (Christianity, especially Catholicism) The adoration (or latria) owed to God alone, as greater than the hyperdulia) that is given to Saint Mary only and the veneration (or dulia) accorded to all other Roman Catholic saints.
(metonymic) The religious ceremonies that express this devotion.
